# E0415: a lacuna on _each has no when

A lacuna applies under the condition its mapping implies; an each implies
none, since it maps every element. A lacuna on an each says when it applies
with `when`.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		title: string
	}]
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		name: string
	}]
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		items: _each(prev.items, {
			name: _item.title
		})
	}
	lacunas: {
		items: [{
			type:    LossyFieldMapping
			message: "titles were renamed"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: (self): {
	prev: {
		items: _each(self.items, {
			title: _item.name
		})
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{name: string}]
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0415]: lacunas.items: a lacuna on _each has no when
  --> history/1.0.thema:14:11
   |
14 |         items: [{
   |                 ^
   |
   = help: say when it applies with when: <condition>
```
